findings.title: Missing Tier-Driven Verified Months Logic in Tier Assignment Engine
findings.location: Design Section 1 (Backend Integration & Wiring), Engine Orchestration table; Requirements FR1.3
findings.problem: The design states 'Tier 1 requires 6+ verified months (AA+UPI with no GST)' but doesn't clarify the decision rule. If a borrower has 6+ verified months but the GST requirement is violated, the tier assignment logic is ambiguous (AND vs OR conditions).
findings.impact: Tier assignment logic ambiguous → Engineering guess at implementation → Potential mismatch with requirements
findings.fix: Clarify exact tier assignment logic with explicit AND/OR: Tier 1: verified_months >= 6 AND (AA_present OR UPI_present) AND NOT GST_registered. Tier 2: verified_months >= 12 AND (AA_present AND (GST_registered OR UPI_present)) AND NOT Udyam_registered. Tier 3: verified_months >= 24 AND AA_present AND GST_registered AND Udyam_registered. Define verified_months = min(aa_months, gst_months, upi_months) if multiple sources.

findings.title: PhotoVerificationEngine Not Invoked in Scoring Pipeline
findings.location: Design Section 1, Engine Orchestration step 3; Requirements FR1.6; Code: scoring_phase1.py, photos.py
findings.problem: Design describes PhotoVerificationEngine as step 3 in scoring pipeline, but code review shows photos.py saves photos without calling PhotoVerificationEngine, and scoring_phase1.py checks verification_status but never calls engine to perform verification. Photos remain stuck in 'pending' status.
findings.impact: Photos uploaded but never verified → Photo verification test fails → Integration test suite incomplete
findings.fix: Add new endpoint POST /api/applications/{id}/verify-photos that calls PhotoVerificationEngine for each photo and updates Photo.verification_status and Photo.verified_at. Or auto-verify during scoring. Include rent_lat/rent_lng in Shop model and challenge_code in Application model.

findings.title: RateCalculationEngine RateAdapter Not Wired; Hardcoded Rates Unclear
findings.location: Design Section 1, Engine Orchestration step 9; Code: scoring_phase1.py, rate_adapter.py
findings.problem: Design claims 'Fetch industry rate from RateAdapter by tier' but doesn't clarify whether rates are stored in RateEnvironment table or hardcoded. RateAdapter implementation and contract not fully specified in design.
findings.impact: Rates unclear (hardcoded vs. dynamic) → Confusion during rate engine wiring → Potential wrong rates in production
findings.fix: Define RateAdapter contract: get_rate(tier: int, db: Session) → {base_rate, adjustment, final_rate}. Clarify rate storage: RateEnvironment table or hardcoded? Verify RateCalculationEngine actually calls RateAdapter. Update error handling table to include 'Rate lookup fails' scenario.

findings.title: Missing Challenge Code Generation and Storage
findings.location: Requirements FR1.6 (Challenge code verification), Design Section 1 (PhotoVerificationEngine)
findings.problem: Design requires 'challenge code verification' but doesn't specify where code is generated, stored, or displayed to borrower. PhotoVerificationEngine expects expected_code parameter but design doesn't define its source.
findings.impact: Challenge codes never generated → Photo verification always fails → Borrowers can't complete application
findings.fix: Add Application.challenge_code column or Challenge table with code, created_at, expires_at. Add endpoint POST /api/applications/{id}/generate-challenge returning {code, expires_in_minutes}. Update PhotoVerificationEngine contract to show code generation step. Clarify timing: generate before or after photo upload?

findings.title: Glossary Endpoint Not Defined; Plain Language Reasons Data Structure Unclear
findings.location: Design Section 2 (Frontend Integration), Plain Language Glossary table; Requirements FR1.7, AC1.7
findings.problem: Design lists 18 glossary terms but no GET /api/glossary endpoint documented in endpoint wiring table. No response schema defined. generate_plain_reasons() function called but not defined in design.
findings.impact: Glossary endpoint missing → Plain language reasons test fails → Borrowers see code names instead of plain English
findings.fix: Add endpoint GET /api/glossary in wiring table. Define response schema: {terms: {term_name: {plain_text, category, examples}}, version}. Document mapping between reason templates and glossary terms. Add test requirement: verify all 18 terms referenced in reason templates.

findings.title: TrancheRuleEngine Eligibility Check Missing Explicit Preconditions
findings.location: Design Section 1, Engine Orchestration; Requirements FR1.4
findings.problem: Design describes TrancheRuleEngine checking 'prior EMI history' but doesn't define: all prior tranches or just immediately prior? Definition of on-time (≤due_date or ≤due_date+grace_period)? Grace period value?
findings.impact: Tranche eligibility rule ambiguous → Wrong tranches released → Borrowers get unapproved amounts
findings.fix: Clarify TrancheRuleEngine logic: (1) Get previous tranche; (2) If no previous: ELIGIBLE; (3) If previous exists: check ALL EMIs have payment_status='ontime' (paid_date <= due_date); (4) If ANY late: NOT_ELIGIBLE; (5) If previous EMI count=0: NOT_ELIGIBLE. Define grace period explicitly (0 days recommended).

findings.title: Load Test Configuration Incomplete; Missing Baseline Metrics
findings.problem: Load test config lacks baseline metrics (1 concurrent user for comparison), database size specification, memory allocation justification, and pre-load warmup phase.
findings.impact: Metrics unreliable → Unsure if system handles 100 users
findings.fix: Add baseline (1 concurrent user, cold start): <500ms p95 response time, <300MB memory. Specify database generation: 10,000 apps with 2 tranches each, 24 EMIs per tranche = ~720k records. Add 30-second warmup phase before measuring. Document machine spec (2GB RAM assumption).

findings.title: End-to-End Data Flow Diagram Incomplete
findings.problem: Data flow diagram shows happy path but doesn't show error/retry paths, timeout handling, or failure states.
findings.fix: Optional: Add error flow paths (e.g., scoring timeout → 500 error → retry button)

findings.title: Glossary Terms Category Mismatch Risk
findings.location: Design Section 2, Plain Language Glossary table
findings.problem: Glossary lists 18 terms in 6 categories, but frontend checklist might define different categories or counts.
findings.fix: Optional: Cross-check glossary with frontend checklist to ensure alignment

A2: StopRuleEngine Invoked on Repayment — Verified in repayment.py line ~73
A3: Database Schema Finalized — Decision model has correct fields
A4: Scoring Endpoint Wired — POST /api/scoring/score orchestrates engines 1-10
A5: Deterministic Adapters — All adapters return mock data with no randomness
unverified_wrong_assumptions: U1: PhotoVerificationEngine Invoked During Scoring — WRONG: Not actually called during scoring
U2: RateAdapter Fetches Industry Rates — UNVERIFIED: Contract and storage unclear
U3: Challenge Code Generation Implemented — WRONG: No generation/storage mechanism documented
U4: Glossary Endpoint Implemented — UNVERIFIED: Not in endpoint wiring table
U5: TrancheRuleEngine Eligibility Logic Fully Specified — UNVERIFIED: Exact criteria not formally defined
summary: Design document is comprehensive in structure but contains 5 critical gaps that must be resolved before implementation: (1) ambiguous tier assignment logic, (2) photo verification not invoked, (3) unclear rate adapter wiring, (4) missing challenge code workflow, (5) missing glossary endpoint. Two medium-severity issues affect testing reliability. Recommend addressing all HIGH and MEDIUM findings before engineering begins.
